issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: Lakeville Man is 23rd Defendant to be Sentenced in Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
supports: Abdinasir Mahamed Abshir was sentenced on 2026-08-18 to 78 months in prison.
USAO-MN described Abshir as the 23rd Feeding Our Future defendant sentenced.
USAO-MN states the sentence also reflected Abshir's 2025-02-18 effort to tamper with a cooperating trial witness during the Bock/Said trial.
does_not_support: The release does not provide a restitution amount in the captured text.
Do not infer a separate witness-tampering conviction unless supported by the plea/judgment; the release says the sentence reflects the obstruction conduct.
